change: In existing tools/delivery/recovery-pr-prioritizer.mjs, incorporate a validated PR base.sha != current mainSha into advisory refreshEvidence while keeping existing exact-head lease validation, active-Required deferral, bounded budget and live compare/CAS authority. Add exact historical replay regression with #3978 versus #5134.

On the existing recovery lane, distinguish actual current-main/PR-base provider evidence; rank valid-lease, recent exact-head green candidates ahead of stale candidates without evidence, then recheck live merge/behind and exclusive owner before mutation. Unknown/malformed base is UNKNOWN, never fabricate drift. Do not create a scheduler or bypass GitHub protections.
